contentBlocks.title: SRD R370 Extension: March 2028 Reports Explained
contentBlocks.description: Reports after the October 2026 MTBPS point to a further SRD extension to March 2028. See what is confirmed, what is reported and what still awaits formal implementation.

contentBlocks.text: What Is Confirmed and What Is Reported?

The SRD R370 grant was officially extended from 1 April 2026 to 31 March 2027 in the February 2026 Department of Social Development announcement. After the 21 October 2026 Medium-Term Budget Policy Statement, several media and civil-society reports described a further one-year extension to March 2028. We have not located a published DSD notice or Government Gazette setting out the detailed implementation of that further year. Treat the March 2028 date as reported and subject to formal implementation until an official notice confirms the details.

The announcement was made following Cabinet approval of the 2026 Medium-Term Budget Policy Statement. The SRD grant, which was first introduced in May 2020 as a temporary COVID-19 relief measure, has been repeatedly extended as unemployment levels remain high. According to Statistics South Africa, the unemployment rate stands at 32.1% as of mid-2026.

items: The grant remains R370 per month; the extension did not announce an increase.
The February 2026 DSD announcement formally confirmed continuation from 1 April 2026 to 31 March 2027.
Reports following the October 2026 MTBPS describe a further year to March 2028, subject to formal implementation.
Existing applications continue to be assessed monthly; check the official portal for any reconfirmation or verification request.
Appeals remain available for declined months; follow the deadline shown by the official appeal service.

contentBlocks.title: Check the official portal before taking action
contentBlocks.text: The extension announcement does not by itself require a new application. Existing applications are still assessed monthly. Check the official SRD portal for any reconfirmation or verification prompt, and follow the instruction shown there. Do not submit duplicate applications unless SASSA instructs you to.

The SRD remains R370 per month. The amount increased from R350 to R370 in April 2024, not May 2023. Monthly eligibility and income checks still apply; an extension does not guarantee approval in every payment cycle.

SASSA may request biometric verification when identity or fraud checks require it. Complete biometric or eLife verification only when you receive an official request, and use SASSA's official channels. Do not assume that every beneficiary must complete an annual biometric check.
Each month, SASSA evaluates your application independently. Being approved in one month does not guarantee approval the next month. Here is what happens behind the scenes each month:

steps.title: Bank verification (1st-10th of the month)
steps.description: SASSA checks your bank account using the automated verification system. They look at all deposits to determine if your income exceeds the means-test threshold of R624 per month.

steps.title: Means-test assessment (10th-15th)
steps.description: Your financial information is compared against the threshold. If your total income is below R624 per month, you pass the means test.

steps.title: Identity and fraud checks (15th-20th)
steps.description: SASSA cross-checks your ID against Home Affairs records, UIF databases, NSFAS records, and other government systems.

steps.title: Status update (after the 20th)
steps.description: Your status for the following month's payment is updated on the SRD portal. You can check by logging in at srd.sassa.gov.za.

steps.title: Payment processing (23rd-31st)
steps.description: If approved, your payment is processed. SRD payments are typically made between the 23rd and the last day of the month.

contentBlocks.text: What About the Proposed Basic Income Grant?

steps.title: Monthly eligibility review
steps.description: SASSA assesses whether you meet the current SRD rules for that month, including the income threshold and other support records.

steps.title: Identity and record checks
steps.description: SASSA may verify identity and compare relevant records with government databases. If a check flags a problem, follow the instructions shown on the official portal.

steps.title: Status update
steps.description: Check your current result on the official SRD portal. Your status can change from one month to the next.

steps.title: Payment processing
steps.description: If approved, your payment is processed through your selected method. Dates vary by payment cycle and method; use the current official notice rather than relying on a fixed monthly window.

contentBlocks.text: Government is developing a longer-term Basic Income Support policy, but its final design and implementation date have not been confirmed. The reported SRD extension does not mean a replacement grant has already been approved or launched.

faqs.question: Do I need to reapply for the extension?
faqs.answer: The extension announcement does not by itself require a new application. Existing applications are assessed monthly. Check the official portal for any reconfirmation or verification prompt and follow the instructions shown there.

faqs.question: Will the grant amount increase before March 2028?
faqs.answer: No increase was announced with the reported extension. The SRD amount remains R370 per month unless government publishes a separate change.

faqs.question: What happens after March 2028?
faqs.answer: The reported extension points to March 2028, but the detailed formal implementation has not been confirmed in a published notice we could locate. Government is also developing a longer-term Basic Income Support policy.

faqs.question: Can new applicants still apply for the SRD R370?
faqs.answer: Yes. The grant remains open to new applicants. If you meet the eligibility criteria, you can apply at any time through the SRD portal at srd.sassa.gov.za.

faqs.question: Will my monthly evaluations change?
faqs.answer: Monthly eligibility checks continue. Approval in one month does not guarantee approval in the next month. Check your status and follow any official verification or reconfirmation request.
